drivers.title: Fed’s Barr Warns of Risks Tied to Looser Wall Street Bank Rules
drivers.explanation: Federal Reserve Governor Michael Barr criticized moves from regulators over the past year to relax the rules for US lenders, saying the proposals “considerably weaken bank regulation and supervision.”

drivers.title: China’s PBOC Adds Gold Again as Bullion Remains Under Pressure
drivers.explanation: China’s central bank extended its gold-buying streak in May, adding to holdings as prices of the precious metal remained under pressure.

drivers.title: World’s Hottest Market Has Korea Bulls Reaching for Protection
drivers.explanation: A wave of optimism over South Korean stocks is giving way to growing caution, as some investors hedge positions and pare back crowded trades on concerns that the rally has run too hot, too fast.

drivers.title: US Proposes New Tariffs Over Forced Labor
drivers.explanation: The Trump administration has hit on a new way to impose tariffs on 60 nations that supply almost all US imports — accuse them of failing to enforce bans on foreign goods made with forced labor. drivers.title: Macro Soothsayers, Stock Analysts See Vastly Different Markets
drivers.explanation: The strongest earnings season in years is coming to a close, and the Wall Street analysts who focus on individual companies have rarely been this bullish.
